Chhattisgarh Launches Free Sand Scheme for Rural Housing Beneficiaries

Chhattisgarh Chief Minister launched the 'e-Ret Sangwari' portal to provide free sand for constructing houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin. The initiative aims to support beneficiaries in building pucca houses. The portal will facilitate the distribution of sand to eligible individuals, streamlining the process for rural housing construction.
